comment: Integration settings. Sensitive values should be injected via environment variables or a secrets manager; do not commit real tokens.

atlassian.note: Enable only when authenticated. WSL may need Windows-side credentials.

jira.note: Override via JIRA_SITE and JIRA_CLOUD_ID environment variables.

youtube_fetcher.note: Video-transcript adapter. Override hosts via BUNDLE_YOUTUBE_HOSTS.
